title: A console for my desk
label: Personal Windows widget
problem: I kept opening three apps to check my AI usage, my calendar and who was on the rota this Sunday.
built: A small Windows widget that sits on my desktop and shows all three at a glance. It is my own fork of TokenFish, an open-source usage tracker, rebuilt around the things I check every day.
outcome: One glance at the corner of my screen instead of three apps.
